content.text: Measured 4 of 5 EQE points; the best so far is at Sb ≈ 0.62. XRD suggests a phase change between 0.57 and 0.62. I'm spending the last EQE point on index 19 (Sb 0.59).

input.rationale: Index 20 (Sb 0.624) had the highest measured EQE, 0.0559%. EQE values were 0.0173 at Sb 0.36, 0.0116 at 0.50, 0.0442 at 0.59, 0.0559 at 0.62 and 0.0463 at 0.67, so the maximum sits near 0.62. By XRD, 0.62–0.71 is a single Sb-rich phase (film reflection near Q≈2.04–2.08 plus a weak peak near Q≈3.40, on top of the FTO peaks). At 0.57 there are extra reflections (Q≈3.33, 3.90), which points to a mixed or Pb-rich phase. The film peak is strongest in this phase at 0.62 and weakens as Sb increases.

content.text:
I submitted **index 20 (Sb fraction 0.624)** as the best composition. Its EQE of 0.0559% was the highest of the five I measured. All 5 EQE measurements were used, plus 4 of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | 0.36 | 0.0173 |
| 12 | 0.50 | 0.0116 |
| 19 | 0.59 | 0.0442 |
| **20** | **0.62** | **0.0559** |
| 22 | 0.67 | 0.0463 |

- **Where the peak is:** EQE drops on both sides of 0.62, so the best composition is probably close to it. Index 21 (Sb 0.65) was never measured, so a slightly higher value between 0.62 and 0.67 can't be ruled out.
- **What XRD showed:** One Sb-rich crystal phase appears from Sb 0.62 to 0.71. Its film peak is strongest at 0.62 and fades toward 0.71, which matches EQE falling as Sb increases. At Sb 0.57 there are extra peaks, suggesting a mixed phase. That fits the drop in EQE at 0.59.
- **Scale:** All the EQE values are small, under 0.06%, so this material is a weak photoanode at any composition on this line.
